free_tier.stated: No published total quota, but a large installed base with published aggregate stats: the downloads index reports 149,920 files totalling 43,307.57 GB and 387,395,913 downloads. Mean file size is therefore ~296 MB, and the tail is much larger - a live listing for `objects3` shows '7.86gb (8,442,728,905 bytes)' on a single file. So 8 GB-class single objects are published and served today.

retention.stated: per-object-cap: verified at least 8,442,728,905 bytes on a live file listing; the widely-cited 8192 MB figure is third-party (TWC wiki, marked TBC by its own author) and is contradicted by the 7.86 GB file, so treat ~8 GB as observed-not-documented. retention: indefinite; files stay downloadable for years

egress.terms: Free, no billing, and the site is Cloudflare-fronted (Server: cloudflare on the live origin). Files are served from the site itself rather than a separate CDN hostname; the mirror endpoint (/downloads/mirror/<id>/<n>/<hash>) is the byte path and is behind the same edge.

tooling: No upload API and no SFTP: the write path is the web 'Add File' form at /downloads/add, gated to logged-in members. There is a 'URL upload' field (fetch-from-URL) which is the closest thing to automation. Read side is plain anonymous HTTP GET from /downloads/mirror/..., plus an MD5 hash published on each file page.
chaining: One account x unlimited game/mod profiles x unlimited files per profile. Because the unit is a *mod page*, not a repo, cardinality is bounded only by how many plausible mod entries you create. 8.44 GB verified per file x N files.
limits_note: per-object-cap: verified at least 8,442,728,905 bytes on a live file listing; the widely-cited 8192 MB figure is third-party (TWC wiki, marked TBC by its own author) and is contradicted by the 7.86 GB file, so treat ~8 GB as observed-not-documented. retention: indefinite; files stay downloadable for years. request-rate: not documented.
reliability_note: Also note the add-file page itself says 'Members only / You do not have permission to add the requested downloads content' when unauthenticated.
